message: Online-only licensing enforcement. AI Training now requires a fresh cryptographically verified signed license-service response before the protected core is allowed to start. Cached/offline revocation data no longer grants gameplay access. While playing, the signed single-file revocation bundle is checked continuously; if live verification becomes unavailable for more than a short retry window, the running game/browser session is terminated. Legacy two-file revocation fallback has been removed so verification uses only the atomic signed bundle. Existing live revoke/delete, hardware blocking, duplicate-key protection, restore behavior, and browser-independent session binding remain enabled.
